summary: Traffic r2 adds the required flat API surface, road-height publication, deterministic hour-based fleets, 11 vehicle classes with three LODs, pedestrians, native lamps/pools/contact shadows, and traffic-owned fallback signals. All 16 standard Metal frames are ready with zero errors (max 143 draws, 1128914 triangles, min 50.2 FPS). Extended behavior and visual checks still fail; this is an incomplete 5.8/10 build for independent critique.
acceptanceMet: 17: traffic ready with zero browser/GL errors at all_12, all_22, and street720; integrated all frames are empty terrain and prove boot compatibility only.

1/4 measured subclauses: worst sampled vehicle surface-height error 0.001623 m and lateral lane error 0.001430 m across four pinned hours; directed single-lane edges are respected by graph construction.
8 measured density: vehicles 86/157/240/39 and pedestrians 63/186/260/35 at 6.5/12/17.5/22; morning box-truck plus semi share 18.60%, peak share 5.00%.
9 measured sidewalk height subclause: maximum sampled pedestrian road-height error 0.000638 m; LOD0 pedestrians 223 triangles and LOD1 70 triangles.

10 source and image subclauses: body and pedestrian meshes cast and receive shadows; contact-darkening patches render; caster-off plate changes 0.434% of pixels at >12 RGB difference, without proving each required long-shadow ratio.
12 implementation subclauses: three vehicle LODs, 1200 m vehicle and 220 m pedestrian culling; LOD2 28 triangles, LOD1 180-316 versus LOD0 1248-1564.

16 measured subclauses: all 36 final captures <=172 whole-frame draws, traffic update <=0.5 ms; extended fixed-step maximum 0.8 ms; no traffic-owned textures and declared budget 60 draws/300000 triangles.
18 API surface exists, including fixed step/freeze, density, forceLod, debug, cropRects, flowGrid, outsideConnections and signalState; save/load count and by-kind roundtrip passed.
21 pinned reproducibility: density-zero drain followed by refill and 600+ fixed steps reproduces first 20 positions, headings, and by-kind counts; IDs intentionally remain monotonic.
6/15/22 measured subclauses: four outside ports; all 16 signal green-arm sets change at half cycle; mast emissive becomes null when a props trafficlight is published.
acceptanceMissed: 5/6/13 fail extended behavior probe: minimum same-lane bumper gap -4.941 m, maximum excess positional jump 30.810 m, maximum heading rate 62.766 rad/s, and junction edgeId-null fraction 12.025%; queue count stays 9-29 during measured cycle rather than draining below 2.
3: semi uses a rigid extended truck body rather than articulated tractor/trailer; class proportions, wheel placement and motorbike/rider need substantial art work.
12/18/19: fleet catalogue specimens are rendered outside the live agent maps; exact agent-to-instance accounting is incomplete. Mast gating hides geometry but reported draw totals do not drop.
9/14/22: pedestrians remain mannequin-like, some crossings miss the zebra, foreground figures can obstruct queue framing, and fallback pedestrian heads lack lit walk/stop lenses.
10: long shadow length and per-vehicle core/contact luminance thresholds have not been established with the required masks; do not infer a current global CSM dead zone.
11: noon junction far_asphalt horizontal speckle fraction 0.2976% exceeds the 0.2% threshold in the measured crop; skyline camera returns no valid far_asphalt crop.
12/13: render interpolation is missing; forced-LOD whole-frame mean absolute difference is 0.491/255 but the required per-vehicle two-pixel bounding-box limit remains unverified.
14/showcase: steep terrain-derived road profile obstructs the prescribed merge view; fleet and queue art remain below the CS2 reference bar.
18/20: explicit routes starting in the reverse direction and road-edit continuity were not fully exercised in this bounded round.

7: nighttime lenses and pools are visible in captured frames, but the full masked radiance/halo/body-colour numeric gate was not completed; synchronous setTime probe does not advance environment night uniforms.
6 integration: all-showcase screenshots contain no roads, vehicles or props masts, so traffic-owned signal direction agreement in a populated integrated city remains unverified.
remainingWeaknesses: Junction transitions still jump and overlap; measured queue does not drain. These are real acceptance failures, not residual-spec exemptions.
Rigid semi, crude motorcycle and mannequin pedestrians; fleet specimens are separate from simulation agents.
Highway/merge grading depends on public road profile support; prescribed merge camera is obstructed by terrain-derived bridge geometry.
Shadow/contact ratio, nighttime masked measurements, per-agent LOD bounds, 30-second heap drift and full road-edit behavior remain unverified.
No far_asphalt landmark at skyline; measured noon junction asphalt speckle is above threshold.
Mast visibility gating works, but its draw-accounting reduction and pedestrian lens states are incomplete.
Integrated all shots are clean empty-world boot checks; populated traffic/props agreement needs a separate integrated scene.

measurements.renderer: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M4, Unspecified Version)
measurements.costCaveat: Whole-frame totals include roads and terrain. Traffic API submission totals describe the main pass; cascade shadow work is not separately attributed. Mast-hidden accounting remains inaccurate.
measurements.latestCodeCheck: All nine traffic JavaScript files pass node --check; git diff --check passed for traffic and its core request.
measurements.sequence: Standard matrix precedes final bounded seed/entry spacing tweaks; queue_final and final probe/plates exercise those latest simulation tweaks.

residualHandling: Pool metre dimensions and peak-to-lens ratios lack the prescribed image instrument: source dimensions are not claimed as a measured pass or fail.
Temporal flicker and silhouette naming are advisory visual judgments; no still-image proof is asserted.
No prescribed spawn/despawn log: near-camera popping exemption is recorded as unmeasured, not failed.
Texture attribution is added as traffic stats textures=0; whole-renderer texture totals are not charged to traffic.
22:00 congestion arithmetic conflicts with permitted free-flow speeds and signal stops; the <=0.10 threshold is not used to fail this build.
Undefined pedestrian 160-220 m band is resolved by extending LOD1 to 220 m.
Catch-up cost arithmetic is noted; actual captured traffic update maximum is 0.5 ms.
